chapter: Radio, theaters and early dance forms
title: The name Jass band
summary: DeDroit says his first band was called a Jass band, a name Mr. Grunewald used.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: helped their music. Were they calling it jazz at that time?

Exactly. My first band was called a Jazz Sass band. They didn't call it jazz, it was called Jazz Sass. J-A-S-S, if you want to look through here you'll find it, S-A-S-S. And we called it jazz. Mr. Grunwald called it the Jazz Sass band. And that was the name it was called, Jazz Sass.
